doctorBrief.heading: Expert in Advanced Gynecological Laparoscopy & IVF
doctorBrief.doctorTitle: Lecturer & Senior Consultant in Obstetrics, Gynecology & Laparoscopy - Cairo University Hospitals (Kasr Al-Ainy)
doctorBrief.p1: Dr. Mohamed Mamdouh Saleh graduated with honors from the Faculty of Medicine, Cairo University (Kasr Al-Ainy), advancing through his academic residency and clinical fellowship to achieve both Master's and Doctoral (MD) degrees with distinction. He holds the prestigious Fellowship of the Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (MRCOG, London) and the European Diploma in Gynecological Laparoscopy (GESEA).
doctorBrief.p2: With over two decades of surgical excellence, Dr. Saleh has conducted thousands of advanced laparoscopic surgeries, organ-preserving myomectomies, and complex endometriosis reconstructions. His patient-first philosophy integrates state-of-the-art IVF protocols and compassionate maternal care, ensuring maximum safety, comfort, and positive outcomes.

painlessBirth.question: Can childbirth be performed painlessly?
painlessBirth.answer: Yes, utilizing advanced modern medical techniques and tailored regional anesthesia protocols (such as Epidural analgesia and Patient-Controlled Analgesia PCA), labor and cesarean pain can be minimized significantly, ensuring a peaceful, safe, and empowering birth experience.

fibroids.question: Can uterine fibroids be treated without a hysterectomy?
fibroids.answer: With state-of-the-art operative techniques and Dr. Mohamed Saleh's extensive expertise in advanced laparoscopy, uterine fibroids can almost always be excised with extreme precision while completely preserving the uterus and the patient's future fertility.

robotic.question: What are the latest techniques in gynecological endoscopy?
robotic.answer: Robotic-assisted surgery and high-definition 3D laparoscopy represent the pinnacle of modern surgical innovation, enabling complex interventions through millimeter incisions with unmatched precision and same-day discharge. Dr. Mohamed Saleh is recognized as a pioneer in these advanced surgical modalities.

hydration.title: Optimal Daily Hydration
hydration.body: Drink 2.5 to 3 liters of water daily to maintain amniotic volume and prevent urinary tract infections.

checkup.title: Routine Screening & Ultrasound
checkup.body: Regular pelvic scans and cervical pap smears detect asymptomatic hormonal shifts and cysts early.

nutrition.title: Targeted Nutrition & Folic Acid
nutrition.body: Prioritize iron and calcium-dense foods, and start folic acid at least 3 months prior to conception.

exercise.title: Safe Physical Conditioning
exercise.body: Consistent walking and guided pelvic floor exercises mitigate back pain and facilitate smooth delivery.

booking.q: How can I book an appointment or consultation?
booking.a: You can book directly via phone with either branch, message our reception on WhatsApp, or submit an online request. Our team confirms all slots within minutes.

robotic.q: What advantages does robotic surgery offer over conventional open surgery?
robotic.a: Robotic surgery provides 10x magnified 3D visualization and wristed instrumentation with greater dexterity than the human hand, reducing bleeding, pain, and hospital stay to under 24 hours.

specialties.q: Do you handle high-risk pregnancies and complex recurrent miscarriages?
specialties.a: Yes, our centers specialize in high-risk obstetrics, recurrent pregnancy loss diagnostics, and advanced fertility preservation, supported by state-of-the-art 4D ultrasound.

branches.q: Where are your clinics located and what are their working hours?
branches.a: We operate two primary clinics in New Cairo (Fifth Settlement: Al-Narges - Ozone Mall BG029) and Madinaty (Medical Center next to City Authority, Clinic 209). Both branches offer advance reservation to eliminate waiting times.
